names: names: each control has the name that the page shows
keyboard: Enter opens the 4 layers in order, and focus goes into each new layer
keyboard: Escape closes 1 layer each time, from the top, and focus goes back to the trigger of that layer
keyboard: Keep labels closes only the confirm and removes nothing
keyboard: Space changes each label, and Save card shows the title and the labels on the card
keyboard: Cancel closes the dialog without a save, and the next open shows the saved card
keyboard: Save card with an empty title saves nothing, keeps the dialog open and puts focus on the title
keyboard: Remove labels in the confirm removes each label from the card and the board
agent: an agent goes through the 4 layers, and the confirm waits for the person
